evidence.shows: Website lists markets on HyperEVM (chainId 999) and ETH Mainnet (chainId 1) as covered-call markets (e.g. WHYPE, kHYPE, wstHYPE, UBTC on 999; WBTC, WETH, wstETH, weETH, rETH, XAUT on 1). It confirms both chains are in use. It shows no contract addresses.

Rysk Premium: per-vault isolated contracts, permissioned or permissionless, epoch-based deposits/withdrawals, RFQ settlement layer. It runs on Rysk V12, live on HyperEVM since June 2025, built on Opyn/Gamma. It credits 5 audits to Trust Security.

Docs home. Rysk is a volatility-yield protocol for covered calls and cash-secured puts via RFQ. It is currently live on HyperEVM and Ethereum mainnet. It links the app, Twitter, Telegram and DefiLlama.
Docs index. It lists a page named 'Important Contracts' at https://docs.rysk.finance/resources/important-contracts.md, plus Oracle, Security and Official links pages.

Audit list: Rysk V12 mk3 + Lean Gamma (current), Lean Gamma Upgrade Procedure Audit (current), V12 mk2, mk1 and mk0 (previous), Rysk Premium mk0 (current). The PDFs are embedded files; direct URLs were not resolvable.

Docs instruct makers to approve USD/asset spending on the HyperEVM address 0x24a44f1dc25540c62c1196FfC297dFC951C91aB4, so the system can exercise for them. The same page refers to an 'accounting and settlement contract' holding maker USDT0. It lists client repos on GitHub (rysk-finance/ryskV12_py, ryskV12_ts, ryskV12-cli). protocol_metadata.about: Rysk lets users earn upfront premiums on crypto assets by selling covered calls and cash-secured puts that are priced via an on-chain RFQ auction among market makers. Collateral is locked in Rysk contracts per position, options are physically settled at expiry, and there is no liquidation. Options issuance and settlement build on the Opyn/Gamma options protocol. Rysk Premium extends this with curator-run, per-vault option-income products on HyperEVM.
